title: Erdős Problem 1186 (k = 3): Lean formalization, verification scripts and computations
description:
Lean 4 formalization, verification scripts and computations for the paper Machine-checked results on the minimum number of monochromatic 3-term arithmetic progressions in two-colourings (Erdős Problem 1186, case k = 3) by Chandler Snively (Quana Labs). For the constant δ3 as defined in the Formal Conjectures project, the formalization proves the bounds 1675/32768 ≤ δ3 ≤ 117/2192 of Parrilo, Robertson and Saracino (Theorem A), the bound δ3 ≥ 14324135/268435456 (Theorem B), and δ3 = 117/2192 (Theorem C). Theorem C is a Lean formalisation of an unrefereed proof claim by Carlos Toledo; its mathematics is Toledo's. Exact certificates outside Lean are included as computational evidence. The problem for general k is not addressed.

The proofs of Theorem B and all the Lean proofs were produced by AI systems in a project directed by the author; see docs/PROVENANCE.md. They have not been checked by an independent human mathematician or peer reviewed.
